mapper.select: select sabun, date_format(day, '%Y-%m-%d') as day, date_format(checkin, '%H:%i:%s') as checkin, date_format(checkout, '%H:%i:%s') as checkout from ta where sabun = #{sabun} and date(day) = curdate()
mapper.insert: insert into ta(sabun, day, checkin) values(#{sabun}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update ta set checkout = now() where sabun = #{sabun} and date(day) = curdate()
mapper.select: select sabun, date_format(day, '%Y-%m-%d') as day, date_format(checkin, '%H:%i:%s') as checkin, date_format(checkout, '%H:%i:%s') as checkout from ta where sabun = #{sabun} order by day desc

WITH RECURSIVE calendar AS ( SELECT DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(CURDATE()), '-01-01')) AS day UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(day, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM calendar WHERE day < DATE(CONCAT(YEAR(CURDATE()), '-12-31')) ) SELECT s.sabun, s.saname, s.sahire, s.deptno, COUNT(CASE WHEN sl.use_date IS NULL AND t.checkin IS NOT NULL AND TIME(t.checkin) <= '09:00:00' THEN 1 END) AS normalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN sl.use_date IS NULL AND t.checkin IS NOT NULL AND TIME(t.checkin) > '09:00:00' THEN 1 END) AS lateCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN sl.use_date IS NOT NULL AND sl.approve = true THEN 1 END) AS leaveCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN (t.day IS NULL OR t.checkin IS NULL AND t.checkout IS NULL) AND sl.use_date IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS absentCount, ROUND( COALESCE( SUM(CASE WHEN sl.use_date IS NULL AND t.checkin IS NOT NULL AND t.checkout IS NOT NULL THEN TIME_TO_SEC(TIMEDIFF(t.checkout, t.checkin)) / 3600 END), 0 ), 1 ) AS totalWorkTime FROM calendar c JOIN sawon s ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN ta t ON t.sabun = s.sabun AND t.day = c.day LEFT JOIN sleave_log sl ON sl.sabun = s.sabun AND sl.use_date = c.day AND sl.approve = true WHERE DAYOFWEEK(c.day) NOT IN (1, 7) AND c.day <= CURDATE() AND s.deptno = #{deptno} AND s.sastatus = '재직' GROUP BY s.sabun, s.saname, s.sahire, s.deptno ORDER BY s.deptno, s.sabun

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN sl.use_date IS NULL AND t.checkin IS NOT NULL AND TIME(t.checkin) <= '09:00:00' THEN 1 END) AS normalCount, -- 정상 출근
COUNT(CASE WHEN sl.use_date IS NULL AND t.checkin IS NOT NULL AND TIME(t.checkin) > '09:00:00' THEN 1 END) AS lateCount, -- 지각
COUNT(CASE WHEN sl.use_date IS NOT NULL AND sl.approve = true AND sl.use_days = 0.5 THEN 1 END) AS halfCount, -- 반차
COUNT(CASE WHEN sl.use_date IS NOT NULL AND sl.approve = true AND sl.use_days = 1 THEN 1 END) AS leaveCount, -- 연차
COUNT(CASE WHEN t.checkin IS NULL AND t.checkout IS NULL AND sl.use_date IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS absentCount -- 결근
FROM sawon s LEFT JOIN ta t ON t.sabun = s.sabun AND date(t.day) = CURDATE() -- 오늘 날짜만 LEFT JOIN sleave_log sl ON sl.sabun = s.sabun AND sl.approve = true AND sl.use_date = CURDATE() -- 오늘 날짜만 WHERE s.sastatus = '재직'

SELECT s.sabun, s.saname, d.dname,
-- 1. 출근일수: checkin(출근시간)이 찍힌 날의 총 개수를 구합니다. COUNT(ta.checkin) AS worked_days,
-- 2. 결근일수: 우선 0으로 던지고 자바 서비스단에서 (기준일수 - 출근일수)로 계산합니다. 0 AS absence_days,
-- 3. 총 연장근무 시간 계산 -- [원리] 퇴근시간과 출근시간의 차이(분 단위)를 구한 뒤, 기본근무 8시간(480분)을 뺀 나머지를 시간 단위로 환산합니다. IFNULL( SUM( CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, ta.checkin, ta.checkout) > 480 THEN (TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, ta.checkin, ta.checkout) - 480) / 60.0 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS overtime_hours
FROM sawon s -- 해당 년월(예: 2026-06)의 근태 데이터만 매핑 LEFT JOIN ta ta ON s.sabun = ta.sabun AND ta.day LIKE CONCAT(#{ym}, '%') JOIN dept d ON s.deptno = d.deptno -- 마감 테이블에 해당 년월 마감 데이터가 있는 사원은 제외 WHERE s.sastatus = '재직' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM salary_closed_attendance sca WHERE sca.sabun = s.sabun AND sca.closed_ym = #{ym} ) GROUP BY s.sabun, s.saname
select status from salary_closed_attendance where sabun = #{sabun} and closed_ym = #{ym}

update.foreach:
insert into ta (sabun, day, checkin, checkout) values( #{sabun}, #{item.day},
concat(#{item.day},' ', #{item.checkin}, ':00')
null ,
concat(#{item.day}, ' ', #{item.checkout}, ':00')
null
) on duplicate key update checkin = values(checkin), checkout = values(checkout)

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO salary_closed_attendance( closed_ym, sabun, standard_days, worked_days, absence_days, leave_days, overtime_hours, status, updated_at) VALUES( #{closed_ym}, #{sabun}, #{standard_days}, #{worked_days}, #{absence_days}, #{leave_days}, #{overtime_hours}, '완료', NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE worked_days = #{worked_days}, absence_days = #{absence_days}, overtime_hours = #{overtime_hours}, status = "완료"

INSERT INTO salary_ledger( pay_ym, sabun, base_pay, overtime_pay, meal_pay, national_pension, health_insurance, long_term_care, employment_insurance, income_tax, local_income_tax, net_pay, status ) VALUES ( #{pay_ym}, #{sabun}, #{base_pay}, #{overtime_pay}, #{meal_pay}, #{national_pension}, #{health_insurance}, #{long_term_care}, #{employment_insurance}, #{income_tax}, #{local_income_tax}, #{net_pay}, '대기' )
mapper.select: SELECT d.dname, COUNT(DISTINCT s.sabun) AS sawonCount, ROUND(AVG( IFNULL(used.totaluse, 0) / 15.0 * 100 ), 1) AS useAvg FROM sawon s JOIN dept d ON s.deptno = d.deptno LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sabun, SUM(use_days) AS totaluse FROM sleave_log WHERE leave_type = 'annual' AND approve = 1 AND YEAR(use_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY sabun ) used ON s.sabun = used.sabun WHERE s.sastatus = '재직' GROUP BY d.deptno, d.dname ORDER BY useAvg DESC;

SELECT ROUND( COUNT(CASE WHEN t.checkin IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) * 100 , 1) AS commuteAvg FROM sawon s LEFT JOIN ta t ON t.sabun = s.sabun AND DATE(t.day) = CURDATE() WHERE s.sastatus = '재직';
SELECT count(*) as leave_sawon FROM sawon s JOIN dept d ON s.deptno = d.deptno WHERE s.sastatus = '퇴직' AND DATE_FORMAT(s.saretire, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(#{date}, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY s.saretire DESC;
SELECT count(*) as joined_sawon FROM sawon s JOIN dept d ON s.deptno = d.deptno WHERE s.sastatus = '재직' AND DATE_FORMAT(s.sahire, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(#{date}, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY s.saretire DESC;
